body:
Same shape as the #1556 logger bug (fixed in #1587): a defaulted parameter
declared before `*args`, so a positional caller silently binds to the wrong
slot.

    cps/db.py:1629 fill_indexpage(..., join_archive_read=..., config_read_column=..., *args)
    cps/db.py:1942 get_search_results(..., offset=..., order=..., limit=..., *args)

Lower severity than the logger case: neither is printf-style, and current
callers pass these explicitly, so nothing is broken today. The risk is the
same trap for the next caller who passes a positional argument expecting it
to land in *args.

Found while tracing blast radius for #1556. Deliberately not folded into
PR #1587 to keep that diff to the defect.
title: db.py: fill_indexpage and get_search_results put defaulted params before *args
